scope: Sparse conjugation, adjoints and conservative Hermitian predicates compose with existing complex matrix operations.
implementation: Sparse conjugate/C and adjoint/H traverse stored coordinates and preserve matrix class and shape.
Three-valued Hermitian checks retain unknown scalar facts while detecting definite mismatches.
Supervised per-occurrence callbacks preserve cumulative invocation/cancellation budgets.
Original matrix and retained dictionary changes are rejected through result construction; later mutated input graphs retain bounded traversal.
Each stored occurrence rechecks callback admission after earlier hooks; changed scalar bindings cannot bypass the shared supervisor.

validation.independent_source_review: root reviewed exact Gram anchors, callback/source snapshots and later-input traversal bounds
validation.exact_gram_fixture: For A=[[1,i],[2i,3]], A.H*A=[[5,-5i],[5i,10]] was checked by hand.
validation.whitespace: No trailing whitespace in reviewed source.
validation.remote_blob_readback: Exact content matched both reviewed candidates; the concurrent native-construction capture was preserved.

limitations: Scalar facts that remain unknown are not promoted to booleans.
Callback supervision cannot forcibly interrupt arbitrary noncooperative Python code.
This commit does not establish broad sparse compatibility, a numerical certificate or a performance improvement.
claim_effects: No WS10, profile or campaign gate closure. Existing status, priority and dependencies remain unchanged.
